fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM38,395. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057138/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Possess Diploma in Nursing from a recognized institution by Malaysia Nursing Board (MNB). Registered with Malaysia Nursing Board (MNB). Possess current Annual Practicing Certificate (APC) for nurses from MNB. Minimum 2 years clinical working experience in nursing. Possess three (3) months experience in the related specialty. For international candidates: Registered with the Nursing Council of the country of origin, pass IELTS minimum score of 5.5 or TOEFL 515/215/80. Student must be certified medically fit by a registered medical practitioner.
